title: Hoa ép trong sách
about: Round 41, thu-vien ("tôi thấy không hay, bạn hãy sáng tác theo ý của bạn và dùng bộ sound phù hợp"), Nocturnes for an Old Library, Pressed Flowers: flowers pressed in an old book, E minor in 3/4 at 56 bpm: a slow sway between C major (its seventh, B, in the tune) and E minor, long floating notes (B, then G-A-B rising to E), the waltz very light and all in the middle (texture waltz); the middle in G major. The piano alone, on thu-vien (ke-chuyen-gan's grand, hall and echo, with nothing heavy: no Rhodes, the lows not lifted, the left hand from C3 with no octave); a singing line in periods, a question and an answer, each return varied; soft, a gentle swell in the middle, no climax. An original tune.
